title: Latent tuberculosis as an operational label
dek: Wikipedia's LTBI page is a test-defined state. It is not DosR physiology and not proof of a named living lesion.
story: Wikipedia's Latent tuberculosis article (Q4254929) describes people with evidence of sensitisation and no active disease. That is an operational category built from TST/IGRA plus a disease work-up, not a PET of a single granuloma.
Simplfy already splits this three ways: tb-latency-dosr (bacillary physiology), tb-igra-tst (the tests), tb-tpt (what programmes do). This card is the encyclopedia name that students search first.

Lifetime progression figures (~5–10% in immunocompetent textbook speech) are glossary, not a personalised risk model. HIV, anti-TNF, silicosis, dialysis, and recent infection move the hazard; those belong on pathogenesis and comorbidity plates.
deep: A negative IGRA does not prove sterility. A positive IGRA does not prove culturable bacilli today.
Incipient/subclinical disease language in research is not the Wikipedia LTBI lead sentence. Do not collapse them.
TPT regimens are WHO objects (3HP, 1HP, 6H, 3HR…). Never dose from this glossary card.
Pediatric and HIV programmes sometimes offer TPT without a test when disease is excluded. That policy is in the TPT module, not here.

visual.caption: Wikipedia LTBI is the middle box: sensitisation tests after disease is excluded. Physiology and TPT are neighbouring plates.

example.title: Positive IGRA, coughing
example.setup: QFT-Plus positive, two weeks of cough, no CXR yet. Someone files 'LTBI, start 3HP'.

steps.title: The Wikipedia label requires disease exclusion
steps.body: Cough is a disease work-up, not TPT.

steps.title: If disease is found, TPT is the wrong object
steps.body: You are now on diagnosis/treatment plates.

example.takeaway: LTBI is a residual category, not a cough protocol.

check.prompt: On Wikipedia and in programmes, LTBI is primarily:
choices: Sensitisation without current TB disease, an operational label
check.answer: Sensitisation without current TB disease, an operational label

whyWrong.Culture-proven necrotic caseum: That would be pathology of disease/lesion.

check.prompt: IGRA+, normal CXR, no symptoms, HIV-negative adult contact. The glossary label is LTBI. The regimen:
choices: Must be read from this Wikipedia card
Comes from WHO/CDC TPT modules (e.g. rifamycin-based short courses), not from Q4254929
check.answer: Comes from WHO/CDC TPT modules (e.g. rifamycin-based short courses), not from Q4254929
